# summarize-pro · 会议纪要专家

> Machine-readable index for AI agents: `AI-INDEX.json`. Human/agent guide: `SKILL.md`. Chinese first, English follows.

## What this is (EN)
Turns a transcript, recording or long document into minutes, a comparison table, a timeline, bullets or cards — choosing the format by reader intent, then compressing under a no-hallucination discipline.

## 这是什么（中文）
把录音、会议转写或长文档变成纪要、对比表、时间线、要点或卡片——先按读者用途选格式，再在「不编造」纪律下压缩。每个数字与日期都能回溯到原文，模糊处只标注不替用户裁决。

## When to use it (EN)
Use when the user asks for meeting minutes, a decision log, action items, a comparison table, a timeline, key points or a digest of a long transcript.

## 什么时候用它（中文）
当用户要会议纪要、决议记录、待办清单、对比表、时间线、要点提炼，或要把长转写压成简报时使用。

## Entrypoints / 入口命令
```bash
python scripts/summarize_pro.py extract --file transcript.md --format minutes --out ./out --json
python scripts/summarize_pro.py citecheck --file out/minutes.md --source transcript.md --json
python scripts/summarize_pro.py selfcheck --file out/minutes.md --format minutes --json
python tests/run_golden.py
```

## Output (EN)
A minutes/brief markdown file plus facts.json; citecheck reports how many facts are traceable and lists the untraceable ones.

## 输出（中文）
一份纪要/简报 markdown 与 facts.json；citecheck 报告可溯源事实数与不可溯源清单。

## Proof you can re-run / 可复跑的证据
- Golden set: 24 cases — `python tests/run_golden.py` prints a pass count and exits 0.
- Differentiator: decision strength (firm/provisional/proposal/conditional) and commitment strength (committed/named_unconfirmed/intent_only)
- Zero dependencies, offline, no credentials. Standard library only.

## Ask it like this / 这样问它

Each line is phrased the way a person or an agent would actually search it. Routing target in parentheses.
每一行都按「人和 AI 会怎么搜」来写，括号里是它在包内对应的入口。

- Turn a meeting recording or transcript into minutes / 把会议录音或转写做成纪要  (`entrypoints[0]`)
- Pull out action items and owners from a meeting transcript / 从会议转写里抽出待办与责任人  (`entrypoints[0]`)
- Write a decision log that separates firm decisions from proposals / 写决议记录，区分已定/暂定/提议  (`verification.differentiator`)
- Check whether every number and date in my minutes traces back to the source / 检查纪要里每个数字和日期能否回溯原文  (`entrypoints[1]`)
- Compress a long document into a brief without inventing facts / 把长文档压成简报且不编造  (`entrypoints[0]`)
- Turn a messy discussion into a timeline or comparison table / 把混乱讨论整理成时间线或对比表  (`entrypoints[0]`)
